req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-038 requires that every response from httpbin includes the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' header. To achieve high mutation kill rate, tests must: (1) assert the exact header value '*' not just presence, (2) cover multiple endpoints to confirm the header is universal, (3) test that the header is absent when the CORS middleware is bypassed (negative path), (4) test boundary conditions such as preflight OPTIONS requests and endpoints that return non-2xx codes. Each test uses the in-process Flask test client and asserts exact string equality on the header value.

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in r.headers
    assert r.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*'

test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint()

tests.name: test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert header value is exactly '*' not a superset or subset
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial():
    r = client.get('/headers')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '')
    assert val == '*'
    assert val != ''
    assert val != 'null'
    assert val != 'http://example.com'

test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial()

tests.name: test_cors_header_absent_without_cors_middleware
preconditions: A plain Flask app without CORS middleware is created
actions: Create a minimal Flask app without CORS headers
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is absent (confirming the header is not a Flask default)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: negative control — confirms CORS header is explicitly added by httpbin, not by Flask itself
tests.executable:
from flask import Flask

def test_cors_header_absent_without_cors_middleware():
    bare_app = Flask('bare_test')

    @bare_app.route('/ping')
    def ping():
        return 'pong', 200

    with bare_app.test_client() as c:
        r = c.get('/ping')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin') is None

test_cors_header_absent_without_cors_middleware()

tests.name: test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Request includes an Origin header with a specific domain
actions: Send GET /get with Origin: http://example.com header
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Origin == '*' exactly, not the requesting origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: value must be wildcard '*', not a reflected origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin():
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Origin': 'http://example.com'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
    assert acao == '*'
    assert acao != 'http://example.com'
    assert acao != 'null'

test_cors_header_value_is_wildcard_not_specific_origin()

tests.name: test_cors_header_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: 'all responses' — decision table covering all HTTP method endpoints
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
        ('GET', '/headers'),
        ('GET', '/cookies'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        acao = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')
        assert acao == '*', f'Expected * for {method} {path}, got {acao!r}'

test_cors_header_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table()
